answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through interactive proof-of-inference. Nodes must solve real-time generation tasks, like composing a constrained sonnet under dynamic token masks. This forces attackers to expend scarce GPU compute per identity, blunting a gale of cloned peers. The resulting trace acts as a lantern, verifying authentic hardware usage. However, this cost excludes resource-limited honest agents and fails against adversaries with massive computational capital.
